normative_source: R did 2.5.1 multiplier bootstrap plus frozen legacy Stata option decisions

accepted.shorthand: wboot reps(#) seed(#) and wboot reps(#) rseed(#)
accepted.seed_top_level: rseed(#) or seed(#) with bootstrap inference
accepted.cluster: cluster() or wboot(cluster(varname)) requests clustered multiplier bootstrap

behavior.legacy_rademacher_mammen: non-rademacher multiplier names are unsupported and fail loudly
behavior.clustered_bootstrap: cluster-summed influence-function multiplier bootstrap is supported for ATT(g,t)
behavior.aggregation_bootstrap: covered by focused event-post bootstrap gates rather than this option-surface fixture
